entries.result: You witness someone being seized and devoured horribly by invisible monsters. Nobody else seems to have noticed this gruesome scene.
Faint whispers reverberate through your current Location.
Shadows take on a life of their own, slithering and writhing like sinister tentacles.
Windows and reflective surfaces start to show twisted and grotesque reflections.
An absolute silence descends upon your current Location, swallowing all sound.
Ancient and indecipherable hieroglyphs materialize on the walls and floor around you.
The walls around you become twisted and elongated, forming strange and impossible angles,
The laws of gravity and physics start to work unpredictably, causing disorientation and vertigo.
Pulsating veins, throbbing with eldritch energy, spread across the surfaces of your current Location.
An unknown and strange color flares in front of you, dances in the air and flows directly into the sky.
A dense fog through which you can see unspeakable horrors engulfs your current Location.
Reality within your current Location becomes tenuous, allowing glimpses into other times and dimensions.
The sun / moon disappears from the sky, bringing an ominous sense of imminent doom.
